text:
anya: heads-up: customers are confused when saved views lose their pinned model across routes. it silently falls back.
prajwal: quick example?
anya: saved on /routes/payments with pin `rw/fast-2`. opened on /routes/checkout shows `rw/fast-1` and no clue why. support gets tickets.
mike: short-term: can we show both requested + applied model in the UI? even a tiny note would help.
ux-bot: suggestion: pill in header: "Saved with rw/fast-2 — opened with rw/fast-1 (region mismatch)". expand -> actions [Use fallback] [Request access] [View details].
infra-bot: backend note: model availability is gated by region/entitlement/quantization. server can return `requested_model`, `applied_model`, and `fallback_reason` in view fetch. telemetry should record if fallback used.
prajwal: API implication? optional field only, right? cannot break old clients.
infra-bot: yes optional. saved_view may include optional `routing_hint` + `portability` flag. default portability=portable -> never blocks. locked means 403-like response if user lacks entitlement.
anya: perfect. can someone add a tiny swagger diff and a telemetry event schema (`saved_view.open` fields)? i can mock the pill copy.
mike: i will add the UI mock and copy suggestions.
prajwal: will add the spec diff today.
anya: thanks. let's roll behind flag to 10% and monitor fallback rate + support tickets.
